import numpy as np


def count_outliers(nums):
    q1, q3 = np.percentile(nums, [25, 75])
    iqr = q3 - q1
    low, high = q1 - 1.5 * iqr, q3 + 1.5 * iqr
    return sum(1 for x in nums if x < low or x > high)
